source.question: A pencil 2.5 cm tall stands upright on the principal axis 21 cm in front of a thin converging lens of focal length 14 cm. Locate the image, find its height and say whether it is real or virtual, upright or inverted.

teachingTimeline.narration: The upright pencil is 21 cm in front of the converging lens; each focus is 14 cm from its centre.
Trace a parallel ray through the far focus and a ray through the optical centre.
The rays meet 42 cm beyond the lens. The image height is −5 cm, so the image is real and inverted.
